report_level_evaluation.results: In a5203-violating-focus-node dataset,finds5 violation-combination patterns,missing object-type links,two missing SHACL constraints and one missing ontology class. Linked views support targeted root-cause tracing and unexpected schema-gap discovery.; limits: Same partner experts participate in design and evaluation;no independent sample/control or quantified efficiency gain. Proprietary case data;toy data available.
